title: Helsinki Grotesk Pro / Opentype-Features
slide_intent: Demonstrate alternate forms in context so typesetters can choose legible and linguistically appropriate glyph behavior.
strategic_value: Explicit feature comparisons can improve consistency in Helsinki’s multilingual text and numeric information.
demonstration: Two columns compare default and substituted forms for ligatures, figures, fractions, case-sensitive forms, scientific notation, localized forms and six stylistic sets.
practical_value: Test the relevant OpenType feature with the intended content before applying it.

content_islands.name: Functional features
content_islands.spec: Left rows pair examples such as fractions, superscripts and localized forms.

content_islands.name: Stylistic sets
content_islands.spec: Right rows compare accessibility forms, slashed zero and script-specific alternates.

reference_purposes.Application: Paired before-and-after glyph samples label OpenType features including fractions, superscripts, localized forms and stylistic sets.
